title: Play breaking news
summary: The user and the assistant engaged in a multilingual conversation where the user first requested to send a "good morning" message to Somodeep on WhatsApp. Despite some initial browser loading errors, the assistant successfully navigated to WhatsApp Web to draft the message. The user then asked to play breaking news on YouTube but quickly clarified that they wanted to hear the song "Breakin' Dishes" instead. The assistant accommodated this by successfully finding and opening the music video in Microsoft Edge. With both tasks accomplished, the assistant concluded the session by offering to help with future tasks, such as brainstorming ideas for AirCursor.
